display.purpose: Geometric display — the two largest title levels only (the hero line and the landing section headings). Regular weight; never on body/UI/data, illustration flourishes, or other headings.

body.purpose: The readable grotesk that runs the whole tool — UI copy, headings (heavier weights), labels. Variable 300–800. Prose capped at 65–75ch.

mono.purpose: The Markdown twin, token counts, durations, technical detail.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Cards, panels and inputs sit flat, lifted only by their surface step (white card over off-white page) and a 1px Hairline border. Flat-By-Default.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Popovers, dropdowns, the result list on hover — a soft neutral shadow.

shadows.name: goldlight
shadows.purpose: Dark mode only — a faint gold glow under the primary action. The one moment the metal radiates.

motion.name: ease-quill
motion.purpose: Default ease-out-quart for state transitions — no bounce.

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion alternative for every transition. The grain stays static and aria-hidden.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The committing action — Continue, Generate, Download. Desert gold fill, near-black text, in both modes (brighter gold on dark).

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis actions — Add to sources, filter toggles. Stark neutral.

components.name: Gold Badge
components.description: The accent badge — a current/selected or hero status. Near-black text on gold, never white.

components.name: Secondary Badge
components.description: Quiet source/type tag — Surface ground, Muted Ink text, no border.

components.name: Status Badge — Success
components.description: Data, not brand — review readiness. Seal Green for a clean punctuated transcript. Status hues are kept distinct from the gold.
components.html: Punctuated

components.name: Search Input
components.description: The home search/paste bar. Pure-white ground over the off-white page; Hairline → gold plus a gold ring on focus.

components.name: Card
components.description: The primary container — search panel, job panel. Pure white, lifting above the off-white page; flat at rest, 1px Hairline, never nested.

narrative.overview: Thothly is a stark canvas carrying a single precious metal. The page is neutral to the bone — a soft off-white by day, a near-black by night, every grey at chroma zero — so that one warm color, desert gold, does all the talking. The gold is the heir of the name (Thoth, writing, the gilt of an illuminated page) but executed bold and modern, not as a costume: a confident metal on an austere ground, paired with a geometric display and a clean grotesk. It is the brand's action color, not a rare flourish, and it is most alive on the black ground where it glows like leaf on vellum. Both modes are stark and first-class; the neutrals only flip lightness, the gold is the constant.
keyCharacteristics: One color only: desert gold. Every other surface is a pure neutral (chroma 0).
Stark, high-contrast neutrals: soft off-white / near-black, pure-white cards lift above the page.
The gold is bold and present — primary actions, focus, active, the mark.
Modern and a little tech: geometric display + grotesk, never editorial.
A single re-skinnable OKLCH token layer drives both modes and the EPUB chrome.

rules.name: The One Color Rule
rules.body: Desert gold is the only chromatic color on the page; every neutral is pure (chroma 0). The gold does all the talking. The only other hues allowed are the four status colors, and those are data, not decoration.

rules.name: The Stark Surface Rule
rules.body: Neutrals carry zero hue — no cream, sand, parchment or blue-grey — and never harsh pure #fff for the page (a soft off-white oklch(0.98 0 0), with pure-white cards lifting above it). Warmth is the gold's job, never the surface's.

rules.name: The Gold-Holds-Ink Rule
rules.body: Gold is a light metal: text on a gold fill is always near-black Ink, never white. The same gold is the primary action in both modes — just brighter on the night ground (no per-mode inversion).

rules.name: The Display Restraint Rule
rules.body: CMGeom is a display face: it carries exactly the two largest title levels — the hero line and the landing section headings — and nothing else (not the working UI, not illustration flourishes, not item/card titles). Every other heading is Host Grotesk in a heavier weight. Never set CMGeom on body, buttons, labels, form controls or data, and never request a bolder weight (Regular only).

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow is a verb — hover, open, focus — never a noun. Depth at rest comes from the surface step (card vs page), not a drop shadow.

dos: Do keep every neutral at chroma 0 — soft off-white Page oklch(0.98 0 0) light, near-black Night oklch(0.13 0 0) dark — and let pure-white cards lift above the page.
Do make desert gold the one color: primary CTAs, focus, current/active, the mark. Bold and present, not rare.
Do use near-black Ink text on every gold fill, and the deeper gold for the light-mode focus ring so it clears 3:1.
Do reserve CMGeom (display) for the two largest title levels (hero + landing section headings) and nothing else; Host Grotesk runs the rest.
Do keep body and placeholder text at Ink / Muted Ink for >=4.5:1.
Do ship a prefers-reduced-motion crossfade for every transition, and keep the grain aria-hidden.
donts: Don't build a cold enterprise dashboard: no soulless corporate gray with no warmth. The gold and the black give it heat.
Don't slip into generic AI SaaS: no gradient hero, no glassy cards, no hero-metric grid, no fluorescent accents, no gradient text.
Don't wear the costume: no papyrus, no hieroglyphs, no sepia, no skeuomorphic parchment. The gold is flat, bold and modern, never a texture.
Don't tint a neutral (no cream, sand, beige, blue-grey) and never use harsh pure #fff for the page.
Don't introduce a second brand color next to the gold; the only other hues are the four status colors (data, not brand).
Don't use white text on a gold fill (it's always Ink), and don't use the brand gold where a status color belongs.
Don't set CMGeom (display) on body, buttons, labels, form controls or data, and don't request a bolder CMGeom weight (Regular only).
Don't add side-stripe borders, decorative shadows at rest, or an uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section.
